stem:
Priya shines three narrow, parallel beams of light at a convex mirror fitted on the gate of her house.
How will the beams travel after reflection from the mirror?

options.text: They remain parallel to each other.
They converge to a point in front of the mirror.
They diverge as if coming from a point behind the mirror.
They are absorbed by the mirror surface.

teacher.key_rationale: A convex mirror causes parallel incident rays to spread out after reflection; the reflected rays appear to come from the virtual focus behind the mirror. Option A is the trap for a student who assumes all mirrors reflect parallel beams as parallel beams; B describes a concave mirror; D contradicts reflection.
